verdict.rationale: The Washington Employment Security Department is a government service platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question here. Nothing in the evidence pack shows one. The docs describe only web portals (eServices, EAMS via SecureAccess Washington), paper forms, and email, mail or fax submission. Probes found no llms.txt, no markdown docs and no OpenAPI spec, and the transactional host sits behind an authenticated login wall.
